name: Engineer Visit Status
query:
SELECT
    ev.name as "Visit:Link/Engineer Visit:160",
    ev.service_request as "Service Request:Link/Swift Service Request:180",
    ev.engineer as "Engineer:Link/User:180",
    ev.visit_date as "Visit Date:Date:120",
    ev.status as "Status:Data:130",
    ev.check_in_time as "Check In:Datetime:180",
    ev.modified as "Last Updated:Datetime:180"
FROM
    `tabEngineer Visit` ev
ORDER BY ev.modified DESC
